errors.text_span: The red Llama-LUFFY-Easy line rises steadily, reaching approximately 0.38 by step 500, while the teal Llama-On-Policy-Easy line rises more gradually, peaking around 0.32 and then plateauing.
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the trends and final values for the 'Easy Training Set' plot. At step 500, the teal line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) is higher (around 0.38) than the red line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy, around 0.35). The description reverses their final relative performance and provides incorrect numerical values and trend descriptions for both.
In the 'Hard Training Set' plot, the red Llama-LUFFY-Hard line ends at a training reward value of approximately 0.2, not 0.18.
In the 'Hard Training Set' plot, the teal Llama-On-Policy-Hard line peaks at approximately 0.03 around step 50, not step 100. By step 100, the line has already dropped back down to nearly 0.0.
